visual_authority.brand_continuity: Approved Calder homepage and shared B1 product-card system

implementation_principle: Restyle and integrate existing product-page functionality; do not replace working Build Your Wheel or Fitment logic.
preserve_functionality: Existing Build Your Wheel option/variant/configuration logic
Existing Build Your Wheel availability, pricing, add-to-cart and request-quote behavior
Existing Fitment selectors, dependencies, compatibility logic and result actions
Shopify product/variant state and existing theme/app integration hooks
Existing cart, quote, inventory and product-form behavior unless a visual wrapper change requires non-destructive adaptation

requirements: Two-column desktop product hero: gallery left, product/configuration right
Large primary wheel/lifestyle image with thumbnail rail below
Breadcrumbs above product content
Product title, construction/category label, short description, rating/SKU metadata
Fitment-confirmed status panel integrated into configuration area
Diameter, width, finish, application and quantity controls
Price and primary Add to Cart CTA
Secondary Save and Share controls
Made-to-order / shipping / secure-checkout trust row
Specifications table on left
Engineered to Perform manufacturing/lifestyle panel on right
Use real Shopify/product metafield data where available; do not hardcode product-specific values

page_regions.target: Function from existing reference, presentation adapted to approved mockup
requirements: PRESERVE existing working Build Your Wheel logic and bindings
Do not recreate, fork, or substitute its functional implementation
Map existing configurable finish choices into the approved Choose Your Finish visual language where technically compatible
Keep center/barrel/hardware configuration controls when required by the existing product type even if the approved mockup shows a simplified finish carousel
Use progressive disclosure or a visually integrated configurator when multiple component finishes are required
Preserve live configuration image/preview, availability, price, cart and quote actions
Approved mockup controls visual hierarchy; existing reference controls functional requirements

page_regions.target: Function from existing reference, presentation adapted to Calder system
requirements: PRESERVE existing working Fitment logic and data flow
Do not replace with static dropdowns
Retain Year, Make, Model and Generation/Trim dependencies as implemented
Integrate fitment state into the product hero where the approved mockup shows Fits Your Vehicle
Retain a full fitment-selection interface where needed to establish/change vehicle
Reuse existing Calder fitment system/API bindings and state rather than introducing a second fitment implementation
Horizontal wheel-finish selector/carousel
Selected state uses restrained Calder gold accent
Selection must bind to existing product/configurator state where applicable
Four-up desktop lifestyle gallery
View Gallery action
Responsive horizontal/stacked behavior without changing source content semantics

page_regions.target: Approved mockup + approved B1 shared card
requirements: You May Also Like product grid
Use approved shared Calder B1 product listing card rather than inventing a new card
Preserve Shopify recommendation/product-list data source
Wheel specialist CTA above footer
Reuse the same Calder footer/header design system established by the approved homepage
Do not create page-specific competing header/footer styling

rules: Preserve hierarchy rather than proportionally shrinking the desktop composition
Stack product gallery and product information on narrow screens
Keep controls touch-usable and prevent configurator/fitment overflow
Allow horizontal carousels where appropriate for thumbnails, finishes, gallery and recommendations

implementation_constraints: Inspect existing theme code before editing and identify exact product template/sections/snippets/assets involved
Prefer extending existing sections/snippets over duplicating business logic
Do not break Shopify Theme Editor schema or merchant-configurable settings
Do not hardcode product IDs, variant IDs, vehicle values, prices, inventory or URLs
Preserve Liquid objects, JS event handlers, data attributes, app hooks and form semantics required by existing functionality
Do not replace existing functional Build Your Wheel or Fitment sections with visual-only mock implementations
Keep changes scoped to the product page/shared components intentionally used by it
Reuse established Calder brand tokens and shared components from the homepage/collection implementation
acceptance_criteria: Product page visually tracks the approved product mockup at desktop
Build Your Wheel remains fully functional after visual integration
Fitment remains fully functional after visual integration
No duplicate configurator or duplicate fitment business logic is introduced
Header/footer remain consistent with approved homepage
No horizontal overflow at 1440, 768 or 390 widths
Theme Check introduces no new product-page errors
Implementation is ready for screenshot-based Sol visual QA
